opportunities.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme (Semester 1, 2027)
opportunities.funding_description: Award amounts range from AUD 5,000 for one semester to AUD 60,000 for one year, determined by ranking and subject to available funds. No individual award amount is guaranteed.
opportunities.deadline_notes: Semester 1, 2027 Round 3 close date: 16 November 2026. Scholarship consideration is automatic for eligible offer holders; offer acceptance deadlines also apply. Verified 2026-10-20.
opportunities.source_snippet: Semester 1, 2027 Round 3 close date is 16 November 2026. Eligible international students with an unconditional offer are automatically considered.
opportunities.application_instructions: No separate scholarship application is required. International applicants apply for a course through the official University of Sydney application route; eligible offer holders are automatically considered. Receive an unconditional offer by the relevant close date and accept it by the deadline stated for the scholarship offer round.

eligibility.notes: Confirmed for the fictional demonstration profile only: it records international status, a coursework Master's offer for Semester 1 2027, that the offer is unconditional, and that study has not commenced. This does not guarantee selection or a particular award amount.

opportunities.deadline_notes: Application deadline 2 November 2026; selection February–March 2027; funding starts October 2027. Verified 2026-10-20.

opportunities.source_snippet: Master's study in STEM at a German university; deadline 2 November 2026; proof of language of instruction at least B1 is required.

Admission to the chosen Master's programme must be obtained before the funding period begins. Confirm country-specific availability in the DAAD database before applying.
